Order Was Made Therein As Under:
Coram: Hon'Ble Mr Justice S.R.Krishna Kumar
 Oral Order
Learned counsel for the petitioners has filed a memo seeking leave of this Court to withdraw the petition.

The aforesaid memo is placed on record which reads as under:
"The undersigned submits that the petitioners are intend to withdraw the petition as not press.
Wherefore it is prayed that this Hon'ble Court may pleased to dismiss the petition as not press, in the above case in the interest of justice."
In view of the memo, the petition is dismissed as not pressed.
